title: Version termination routing and compatibility assistant
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define and implement a standardized end-of-support workflow for older model versions that ties together: automated customer notices, console and SDK compatibility guidance, version pinning controls, and a published performance/latency profile provenance so customers can make migration decisions with data. This ticket covers the PM orchestration, message templates, guardrails for automated notices, and acceptance criteria for engineering and design handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a three-stage customer notice schedule (90d initial, 45d reminder, 15d final) with opt-in extended support flow
Console: show deprecation banner on workspace + per-model page with clear recommended replacement and compatibility score
SDKs emit a runtime warning when calling a deprecated pinned version and include migration hints and a link to the performance profile
Pinning API: support a read-only deprecation flag and an override flow for enterprise customers with audit logs
Performance profiles for affected versions are published with dataset provenance, P50/P95 token latencies, and typical token cost estimates
An internal runbook exists for exceptions, emergency re-enablement, and rollback of automatic sunset actions
Telemetry: track migration rate, number of pinned customers refusing migration, and customer support tickets created related to deprecations
notes: Design decision: prefer progressive, informative notices with clear next steps rather than aggressive forced migration to reduce support churn

Trade-off: automatic unpin after final notice for non-enterprise accounts vs manual opt-out for enterprise customers — decided to opt for automated action for self-serve accounts and manual review for enterprise
Risk: publishing detailed performance metrics may surface model copyright provenance questions; legal to review performance provenance blurb
Implementation plan: backend flag + migration_suggestions API, console UI banner, SDK warning strings, email template generator service
We will reuse the existing rollout/fallback policy infra (see ENG rollout tickets) to perform staged capacity switches if migration is requested by batches of customers
